detail.longDescription: I just updated to # Mastodon v5.0.0-beta.1. It seems to be working great! Question: My home feed always has a hovering "Scroll to top" button at the top. As soon as I start scrolling down to read, new posts load at the top and the button appears and stays. It persists even when slow mode is enabled. Is there a way to hide this button? # mastodonhelp # homelab # selfhosting # selfhosted
